instruction: Disable the background cone icon in VLC interface preferences.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling background cone display in VLC preferences (Tools > Preferences > Interface > Qt interface > Display background cone). The evaluator checks VLC config file for qt-bgcone=0. Uses existing check_qt_bgcone metric from vlc.py.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement: checks qt-bgcone=0 in VLC config file to confirm background cone icon is disabled
Complete coverage: instruction has single requirement (disable background cone), evaluator checks exactly this setting
Correct data flow: get_vlc_config extracts VLC config file, check_qt_bgcone parses it and validates qt-bgcone setting
Expected value is semantically correct: '0' means disabled (default is '1' for enabled)
Robust implementation: metric handles missing config file, missing setting (defaults to '1'), and type conversion
No postconfig needed: VLC config file persists after preferences dialog is closed, getter can access it anytime
